title: SWAGA SCRIPT RAGE FUNCTION PC + MOBILE
features:
Join My Telegram to get Updates

ESP

· Highlight survivors
· Highlight killer
· Tracers (lines from top of screen)
· Highlight generators
· Highlight pallets
· Generator repair percentage
· ESP max distance
· Custom colors (survivor, killer, generator, pallet, percentage)

Movement

· Fly (speed adjustable)
· NoClip (toggle, key V)
· Spinbot (rotation speed)
· Moonwalk (key M)
· Speed Glitch (power)
· Super Jump (power)

Combat

· GodMode
· Heal health

Utilities

· Teleport forward (distance, key T)
· Walk speed (up to 500)
· Vault speed (window climbing)
· Auto Skillcheck (Great)
· Set all boosts to 100

Visuals

· Increased FOV
· Crosshair
· Pink particles
· Rainbow character (color change speed)
· Trail
· Character glow (intensity, color)
· Shadow trail (length, transparency, color)
· Particle storm (count, size, speed)
· Aura (radius, transparency, color, random color)

Environment

· Time of day change
· Fullbright (max brightness, no shadows)
· Custom skybox
· Remove fog

Teleport & Troll

· Teleport to selected player
· HeadStalker (teleport to killer's head)
· BackStalker (teleport behind killer)

Combat (advanced)

· Aimbot (smoothness, FOV, team check, visibility check)
· Fake Lag (intensity)
· Anti-Cheat Bypass (notification only)
· Chams (color, transparency)
· Custom crosshair (dot, cross, circle, square; size, color, outline, gap, thickness)

NEW (extra)

· TP Lobby (with return)
· Teleport to custom exit points (7 locations + temp NoClip)
· Escape from hang (old method – repair nearest generator)
· Escape from hang (new method – repair all generators)
· Kill Aura (auto‑attack all players, increases walk speed)
· Open nearest gate (key G)
· Hitbox Expander (for killer, adjustable size)
· Fling script loader
· Anti‑fling (protection)
· Show my coordinates (copy to clipboard)
· Reset saved positions
· 4:3 aspect ratio mode
